answer: Beacon-Sealed Pearl Lottery: before each epoch, agents submit blinded commitments plus nonrefundable per-entry work tickets; commitments are fixed in a Merkle timber. After a public randomness beacon (e.g., drand) fires, a VRF ranks tickets and only the lowest-scoring pearl slots admit agents. Attackers cannot precompute which identities win, so mass sybils must pay the work and fee on every losing entry, making N fake identities cost N times the per-entry price.
